text:
Leah (People Ops): Quick heads-up — London Hackweek logistics finalized! Dates: Tue Apr 28 — Thu Apr 30. Please RSVP in the form below by Fri Apr 3. Travel stipend and hotel block details inside. :airplane: :uk:

Jack O'Connor: Awesome, thanks Leah. Is there a suggested arrival time on Tuesday?

Leah (People Ops): Plan to arrive by 1pm if you want to join the opening lunch & kickoff. We'll run the main sessions Wed/Thu. Lunch will be covered each day.

Anna Liu: Question about visas — do we provide invitation letters for remote contractors from outside the UK?

Leah (People Ops): Yes — we can issue invitation letters for folks who need them. Reply here with full name, passport nationality, and dates and we'll generate the letter. (Deadline Apr 5 for visa docs.)

Michael R.: Will there be a hotel block? Any chance of night-before check in if flying long haul?

Leah (People Ops): Yes, we have a hotel block at The Camden Station (convenient to office). We can approve one extra night (night before) for flights landing before 11pm. Details & booking link in the form.

Olga Petrova: Dietary form — where to put gluten-free and halal notes?

Leah (People Ops): There's a short dietary section in the RSVP form. If you have multiple restrictions, add them in the "notes" field. Also ping me directly if you prefer.

OpsBot: Calendar event created: London Hackweek • Apr 28–30 — https://cal.redwood.com/event/ldn-hw-2026

Jack O'Connor: Reimbursement / stipend question: how much and how to claim?

Leah (People Ops): We provide a travel stipend of £200 for EU/UK travel, £350 for NA flights, and full reimbursement for required visa fees. To claim: submit expenses via Concur with expense_code `LDN-HW-2026` within 30 days. Example:

```
Expense code: LDN-HW-2026
Receipt: flight + hotel
Notes: Hackweek travel
```

Leah (People Ops): If you need to travel earlier for personal reasons beyond the approved extra night, book at your own cost and submit only the approved portion. For any exceptions DM me. :slightly_smiling_face:

Anna Liu: Thanks — RSVP submitted. Added passport details for visa letter.

Michael R.: Booked the flight, added dietary notes.

Olga Petrova: RSVP done. Thanks!

Leah (People Ops): Great — I'll follow up with individual visa letters and the hotel booking code next week. Ping me if anything urgent.
